description: Fix empty spaces in internal pages (Schedule, Results, Matrix, Research, Profile) and add visual richness to homepage with animations and micro-interactions
steps: 1. Improve SchedulePage in frontend/src/pages/student/MorePages.tsx: Add summary stats cards at the top (total lectures this week, next lecture info). Add a grid-based visual timetable representation. Use MetricCard components (already imported) with Calendar, Clock icons to show 'محاضرات هذا الأسبوع: 7' and 'القادمة: نظم المعلومات'. Add a color-coded day indicator next to each day section.

2. Improve ResultsPage in frontend/src/pages/student/MorePages.tsx: The page already has MetricCards and grid-2 layout. Add a GPA trend summary card showing semester-over-semester with a simple CSS bar chart (no chart.js needed since it requires canvas setup). Add a 'study recommendation' card using AlertRow pattern.

3. Improve MatrixPage: The page already has good content with legend, gaps, and course grid. Add a summary statistics row at the top showing total concepts mastered/total, average mastery %, and streak days. Use the existing MetricCard pattern from components/primitives.

4. Improve ProfilePage: The page already has detailed content (hero card, KPIs, academic links, info, achievements). This page is actually well-filled. Minor improvement: add a 'last login' or 'account age' stat to the KPI row.

5. Add homepage (LandingPage) visual enhancements in frontend/src/styles/visual-final-polish.css: Add scroll-triggered animation delays using CSS custom property --stagger-index on landing sections. Add a subtle parallax effect on .landing-hero-showcase cards using CSS transforms. Add hover micro-animations on .landing-bento-card (scale, shadow lift). Add pulsing glow on .landing-final-cta-btn. Add smooth gradient animation on .landing-hero background.

6. Improve text clarity and design consistency across the platform in frontend/src/styles/visual-final-polish.css: Set minimum font-size for body text (14px). Ensure .page-subtitle has at least 15px size and adequate line-height (1.6). Add letter-spacing improvements for Arabic text readability. Ensure consistent card padding (--sp-5 minimum). Add color contrast improvements for .text-subtle and .text-muted classes.
acceptance_criteria: SchedulePage has summary metric cards at top reducing perceived empty space
ResultsPage maintains its existing layout but has additional analysis cards
LandingPage has CSS hover animations on bento cards and CTA pulse
Text sizes across platform have minimum 14px for body, 15px for subtitles
All CSS uses existing custom properties from tokens.css (no hardcoded colors)
No TypeScript errors introduced - all new JSX uses existing component patterns
No new package dependencies - only existing lucide-react icons
verification: Read modified MorePages.tsx and verify TypeScript validity (correct imports, proper typing)
Verify CSS additions use only existing custom properties and valid CSS syntax
Verify no new external dependencies are imported
findings: Clock and Presentation icons confirmed available in lucide-react (used in DashboardPage.tsx and GlobalSearch.tsx). MetricCard accepts value as ReactNode so string values are valid. ThemeColor includes brand/green/purple. Card component accepts title+icon props. All CSS uses existing custom properties from tokens.css. No new dependencies introduced.
